calculation.description: For each tradable asset, take the cross-sectional median five-trading-day return of all other tradable assets, excluding the asset's own return. The signal is point-in-time and uses only completed observations through t.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2020-2022 (IC 0.05663, ICIR 0.19321), 2023-2024 (0.04560, 0.14564), 2025-2026H1 (0.02029, 0.06855), and 2026-07-01 through 2027-02-25 (0.02026, 0.07266). Later-regime ICIR is below the gate, so monitor drift and use conservatively.
